package.name: belief_empathy_demo
package.description: Bramblett and Bezzo's heterogeneous team out of radio contact, on ePlanSys: an aerial vehicle that finds a task seeks a ground vehicle at its belief particles, and a ground vehicle with a fault tracks the particle the others expect of it. Aletheia's policy against the paper's own procedure, its ideal method and its flock method, in Gazebo.
